test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

My history assignment __is due on__ Wednesday.
solution:
The correct answer is "**No improvement**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **The given sentence is grammatically correct.**
 
• There is no need to change "due on" to "due at" or "dues in".
 
• In option 1, "are due at" is incorrect because "at" is used for a specific time, not a deadline.
 
• In option 4, "is dues in" is incorrect because "dues" is not the correct form of "due".
 
• In option 3, "Were due on" is incorrect because it uses the past tense, while the assignment is still due in the future.

Hence, the **correct answer is option 2**
